metadata.description: Keel — lay the foundational documentation suite for a greenfield software project through a guided, multi-persona interview.

plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Interview the founder about a new project idea, then generate the right set of foundational docs (CLAUDE.md, BRD, PRD, ARCHITECTURE, LLD, ADR, NFR, and more) ready to build from with Claude Code. Then keeps building on them: /keel phase new, /keel change, /keel closeout, /keel upgrade (incl. 1.x → 2.0 format migration), /keel archive, /keel version. v2.4.2: one verdict per doc (ok/waived/archive/split/manual) — archives, ADR indexes, generated and heading-less docs no longer flagged for splitting; waivers in .keel/meta.json; keystone moves sections out instead of compressing.
